response.justification: Bogdan possesses strong domain expertise in geospatial data through his work on GISCollective and Open Green Map, as well as extensive experience building high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems. However, his recent tech stack heavily leans towards TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. His C++ experience is quite dated (2014-2015) and he lacks Rust experience, making him a borderline candidate despite his clear seniority and strong engineering fundamentals.
strengths: Extensive domain experience in geospatial data platforms and GIS applications.
Proven track record of building high-throughput, low-latency microservices.
Strong engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, and Staff-level technical leadership.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience in C++ or Rust, the primary required languages.
C++ experience is limited to a brief period in 2014-2015 and academic projects.
Recent roles focus heavily on full-stack web technologies rather than backend systems-level routing pipelines.
